properties.smsText: Buses replace trains between Sydenham and Central
properties.speechText:
Saturday 5 and Sunday 6 September
Buses replace trains between Sydenham and Central.
Trains run to the normal timetable between Macarthur, Revesby and the City via the Airport.
Trackwork on the T4 Illawarra and South Coast lines may also affect how you travel.
Change at Central for trains towards Bondi Junction, buses to T4 Illawarra and South Coast Line stations, or if you have luggage or accessibility needs.
Sunday, metro services do not run between Sydenham and Tallawong.

Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.
